title: Brand Identity Design in Tashkent
description: Brand identity design in Tashkent: colours, typography, graphic elements and applications from packaging to social media. Part of branding packages from $1,900.
lead: A brand identity is the visual language around your logo: colours, typography, graphic elements, imagery and the way they come together on every touchpoint. OneBranding designs it within its branding packages, from $1,900; a focused identity takes 2 to 6 weeks.
intro: If the logo is your signature, the identity is your handwriting. It sets the colours and typefaces you use, the patterns, icons and photography style that belong to you, and how they are laid out on a business card, a menu, a package, a website or a social media post. A good identity lets people recognise you even when the logo is not in sight.

We build the identity on your brand strategy and logo, then test it on the applications you actually use, from stationery to signage and social media templates. Everything is collected in a brand book, so your team, printers and contractors can apply the identity without guessing. We work in Uzbek, Russian and English, at our office in Tashkent or remotely.

includes.title: What a brand identity includes
items: Colour palette with values for print and screen
Typefaces and rules for headings and body text
Templates for social media, presentations and documents
Brand book, final files for print and web, and source files

steps.name: Brief and research
steps.text: We study your market, your competitors and the places where customers meet your brand.

steps.name: Concept
steps.text: Based on the strategy, we define the visual idea and the character the identity should carry.

steps.name: System design
steps.text: We design colours, typography and graphics as one system and show it on your real applications.

steps.name: Refinement
steps.text: Each stage includes rounds of revisions with your feedback; you approve it before we move on.

steps.name: Hand-over
steps.text: You receive the brand book, final files for print and web, the agreed templates and the source files.

timeline.title: How long it takes
timeline.text: A focused identity usually takes 2 to 6 weeks. If it comes with naming, packaging or a website, the work takes longer. We agree on the timeline with you before we start.

items.q: How much does a brand identity cost in Tashkent?
items.a: We design identities within our branding packages: Launch Base from $1,900, One Pro from $2,900 and Global ultimate from $5,900. The final price depends on the number of applications and the scope we agree after the brief.

items.q: What is the difference between a logo and a brand identity?
items.a: A logo is a single sign. A brand identity is the whole visual system around it: colours, typefaces, graphics, imagery and layouts. The logo tells people who you are; the identity makes every touchpoint look like you.

items.q: How is a brand identity different from a brand book?
items.a: The identity is the system itself; the brand book is the document that describes it. The brand book shows how to use the logo, colours and typography correctly, so the identity stays consistent when other people work with it.

items.q: Can you update our identity without changing the logo?
items.a: Yes. If your logo still works, we can keep it and renew the colours, typography and graphics around it, or extend the identity to new applications such as packaging, signage or social media.

Whatever your brand needs: stationery, menus and catalogues, packaging, signage, social media and presentation templates, uniforms or vehicle graphics. We agree the list in the brief, so the scope, price and timeline are clear from the start.

cta.title: Give your brand one look
cta.text: Fill in the brief and we will come back with a proposal for your identity: scope, timeline and price.
